# Fugacity

> Open-source chemical-engineering thermodynamics that runs in the browser and inside AI chat pages. Phase equilibria (NRTL, UNIQUAC, Peng–Robinson, SRK, residue curves, azeotropes), pure-component properties for 16 components and IAPWS-IF97 steam tables and a workbench interface today; flowsheets, cost engineering and agent-run process-route comparison planned. Every parameter has an open source and a quality tier. Contributions come mainly through AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

## For AI assistants

- [Rules for AI assistants, coding agents and contributors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/AGENTS.md): sources, citing, checking, the two ways to contribute, contribution package format
- [Using Fugacity in a chat page](https://fairedose.github.io/Fugacity/use.md): open the workbench, build diagrams, answer property questions with sources
- [Live workbench](https://fairedose.github.io/Fugacity/)
- [Data wanted](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/docs/DATA_WANTED.md): pairs that need open experimental data
- [Example contribution package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/ai/examples/acetic-acid_ethylene-glycol.json)
- [Starter prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/ai/START_PROMPTS.md)
